input.command:
python3 -c '
import json, math

with open("/work/history.jsonl") as f:
    lines = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

x, y, th = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
for item in lines:
    action = item.get("requested_action", {})
    turn = action.get("turn_deg", 0.0)
    move = action.get("move_m", 0.0)
    th = (th + turn) % 360.0
    rad = math.radians(th)
    x += move * math.sin(rad)
    y += move * math.cos(rad)
    f_id = item["frame"]
    st = item.get("status")
    col = item.get("collision")
    print(f"Frame {f_id}: th={th:.1f}, x={x:.3f}, y={y:.3f}, status={st}, col={col}")
' | tail -n 15
